items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I had Jimmy Dorsey’s old horn.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a great pleasure to have with us John LaPorta, who has a resume that goes on and on, and I would read it except we only have an hour. So we’ll have to see if we can kind of focus in on a few of the many things you’ve done. And you obviously are a clarinet player and a fine alto saxophonist.

I don’t play alto anymore. I did for twenty years. I changed — I was originally a tenor saxophone player, and I changed to help a band out and wound up playing it for twenty years. And then when I went to Berklee I wound up playing in the saxophone quartet there with Joe Viola, and played tenor and I didn’t want to play both. I had Jimmy Dorsey’s old horn.
